functions.name: Auto-tag by Role
functions.description: Applies the tags mapped to the roles of the user who created the entry. Pass the entry ID; the user is read from the entry's sys.createdBy.

actions.name: Auto-tag by Role
actions.description: Looks up the user's role and applies the mapped tags to the entry

parameters.name: Entry ID
parameters.description: The ID of the entry to tag. Required, except when simulating a role.

parameters.name: Dry run
parameters.description: Work out the result without writing any tags. Leave unset in an Automation.

parameters.name: Simulate role
parameters.description: Use this role ID instead of the entry creator's roles. Dry run only; used by the Troubleshooting tab. Leave unset in an Automation.
